title: OpenTelemetry Collectors
description: Pipeline health of the three OpenTelemetry Collectors (otel-agent DaemonSet, otel-gateway Deployment, otel-logs DaemonSet): data received vs sent vs refused/failed per signal, processor drops, exporter queues, Kubernetes metadata enrichment, file tailing and collector CPU/memory. Built from the collector's internal telemetry (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/internal-telemetry/, level normal) following the community reference dashboard 'OpenTelemetry Collector' (grafana.com 15983, rev 31). No official dashboard is published by the OpenTelemetry project.

list.name: Firing alerts
list.textFormat: Prometheus ALERTS series in state firing. See Alertmanager / alert rules for details.

list.name: Container restarts
list.textFormat: kube-state-metrics saw the restart counter change (crash, OOMKill or liveness failure).

list.name: Collector config rolled out
list.textFormat: The opentelemetry-operator reconciled a collector CR (new config / image), pods may have been rolled.

options.content:
**Pipeline in this lab**

`apps (SDK) / OBI --OTLP--> otel-agent (DaemonSet) --OTLP--> otel-gateway (Deployment) --> Tempo (traces) / Prometheus /api/v1/otlp (metrics, span metrics, service graph) / Loki (logs)`
`/var/log/pods + Kubernetes events --> otel-logs (DaemonSet) --OTLP/HTTP--> Loki`; the VPS sends to the gateway's authenticated receiver `otlp/external` (https://otel.<domain>).

**How to read**: for each signal compare *received* with *sent*; anything in the *refused / failed / dropped* panels is
data that did not make it. *Exporter queue usage* near 100% means the backend is slower than the input (next stop:
enqueue_failed = data loss). Processors legitimately drop items (`filter/noise` drops health-check spans on the agent).

**Healthy**: all collectors up, loss panels empty, queue usage ~0%, memory well under the container limit
(GOMEMLIMIT is 200 MiB on the DaemonSets, 800 MiB on the gateway; memory_limiter refuses data at 80% of the limit).

**Empty panels are expected** for signals nobody sends: today no workload exports OTLP traces/metrics (OBI only
instruments `staffops*` namespaces, which do not exist yet), so only the *Logs* row of otel-logs moves. Counters
appear the first time something increments them.

**Debug**: `kubectl --context k8s01 -n opentelemetry logs ds/otel-logs-collector` (or `deploy/otel-gateway-collector`,
`ds/otel-agent-collector`). Metric names: [internal telemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/internal-telemetry/); collector v0.165 exposes counters
**without** the `_total` suffix.

panels.title: Collectors down
panels.description: Collector pods whose telemetry endpoint (:8888) failed its last scrape (`up == 0` for the otel-*-collector-monitoring jobs). Non-zero = a collector is down or hung; kube-prometheus alert TargetDown covers it after 10m.

panels.title: Receiver refused + failed (1h)
panels.description: Items (spans + metric points + log records) refused or failed at receivers in the last hour, all collectors. Refused = back-pressure from memory_limiter.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_spans{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Export failures (1h)
panels.description: Items exporters could not deliver (send_failed after retries) or could not queue (enqueue_failed) in the last hour. Any value = data lost.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[1h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Max exporter queue usage
panels.description: Highest sending-queue fill ratio of any exporter (queue_size / queue_capacity, grafana.com 15983 'Exporter Queue Usage'). At 100% new data is rejected (enqueue_failed).

targets.expr: max(max by (job, exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}) / min by (job, exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}))

panels.title: Log records sent / s
panels.description: Log records delivered to Loki per second by all collectors (`otelcol_exporter_sent_log_records`). The main live signal of this lab.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Container restarts of the collector pods (kube-state-metrics). Config changes roll pods (new pod, not a restart); restarts mean crashes or OOMKills.

panels.title: Collectors
panels.description: One line per collector pod: version (`target_info`), uptime (`otelcol_process_uptime`), CPU cores (`otelcol_process_cpu_seconds` rate), RSS (`otelcol_process_memory_rss`) and Go heap (`otelcol_process_runtime_heap_alloc_bytes`).

panels.title: Spans: received vs sent
panels.description: Spans accepted by receivers (`otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans`) and successfully sent by exporters (`otelcol_exporter_sent_spans`), per collector. In a healthy pipeline sent ~= received (times the number of exporters fed by the pipeline; minus what processors filter on purpose). Formula: official internal telemetry docs (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/internal-telemetry/) and grafana.com dashboard 15983 'Receivers'/'Exporters' panels.

panels.title: Spans: refused / failed / dropped
panels.description: Losses (should all be empty or 0). Receiver refused (`otelcol_receiver_refused_spans`: the pipeline pushed back, typically memory_limiter) and failed (`otelcol_receiver_failed_spans`: internal error); exporter send_failed (`otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans`: the backend rejected the data after retries - data lost) and enqueue_failed (`otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans`: sending queue full - data lost). Collector docs recommend alerting on any sustained refused/send_failed rate.

panels.title: Metric points: received vs sent
panels.description: Metric points accepted by receivers (`otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points`) and successfully sent by exporters (`otelcol_exporter_sent_metric_points`), per collector. In a healthy pipeline sent ~= received (times the number of exporters fed by the pipeline; minus what processors filter on purpose). Formula: official internal telemetry docs (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/internal-telemetry/) and grafana.com dashboard 15983 'Receivers'/'Exporters' panels.

panels.title: Metric points: refused / failed / dropped
panels.description: Losses (should all be empty or 0). Receiver refused (`otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points`: the pipeline pushed back, typically memory_limiter) and failed (`otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points`: internal error); exporter send_failed (`otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points`: the backend rejected the data after retries - data lost) and enqueue_failed (`otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points`: sending queue full - data lost). Collector docs recommend alerting on any sustained refused/send_failed rate.

panels.title: Log records: received vs sent
panels.description: Log records accepted by receivers (`otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records`) and successfully sent by exporters (`otelcol_exporter_sent_log_records`), per collector. In a healthy pipeline sent ~= received (times the number of exporters fed by the pipeline; minus what processors filter on purpose). Formula: official internal telemetry docs (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/internal-telemetry/) and grafana.com dashboard 15983 'Receivers'/'Exporters' panels.

panels.title: Log records: refused / failed / dropped
panels.description: Losses (should all be empty or 0). Receiver refused (`otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records`: the pipeline pushed back, typically memory_limiter) and failed (`otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records`: internal error); exporter send_failed (`otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records`: the backend rejected the data after retries - data lost) and enqueue_failed (`otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records`: sending queue full - data lost). Collector docs recommend alerting on any sustained refused/send_failed rate.

panels.title: Items dropped/filtered by processors
panels.description: Items that went into a processor but did not come out: `otelcol_processor_incoming_items - otelcol_processor_outgoing_items` per processor and signal (both counters are documented in the collector internal telemetry; their difference is what the processor dropped, filtered or refused). Expected for filter/noise (health checks); anything on memory_limiter or k8s_attributes is unexpected.

targets.expr: sum by (job, processor, otel_signal) (rate(otelcol_processor_incoming_items{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (job, processor, otel_signal) (rate(otelcol_processor_outgoing_items{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Processor throughput
panels.description: Items per second entering each processor (`otelcol_processor_incoming_items`), per signal: shows where data flows in each pipeline.

panels.title: memory_limiter refusals
panels.description: Items refused by the memory_limiter processor because the collector is near its memory limit (`otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_refused_*`; accepted counterpart `otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_accepted_*`). Refusals propagate to receivers as 'refused' and clients retry. Empty = never refused since start.

targets.expr: sum by (job) (label_replace(rate(otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_refused_spans{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]), "signal", "spans", "", "") or label_replace(rate(otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_refused_metric_points{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]), "signal", "metric_points", "", "") or label_replace(rate(otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_refused_log_records{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]), "signal", "log_records", "", ""))

sum by (job) (label_replace(rate(otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_accepted_spans{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]), "signal", "spans", "", "") or label_replace(rate(otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_accepted_metric_points{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]), "signal", "metric_points", "", "") or label_replace(rate(otelcol_processor_memory_limiter_accepted_log_records{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]), "signal", "log_records", "", ""))

panels.title: Batch size (avg) and send triggers
panels.description: Average items per batch sent (`otelcol_processor_batch_batch_send_size` sum/count) and what triggered sends: size reached vs timeout (`otelcol_processor_batch_batch_size_trigger_send`, `..._timeout_trigger_send`) - grafana.com 15983 'Batch Metrics'. Mostly timeout triggers = low traffic (normal here). The histogram is exported only where the batch processor has processed data.

targets.expr: sum by (job) (rate(otelcol_processor_batch_batch_send_size_sum{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (job) (rate(otelcol_processor_batch_batch_send_size_count{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Batch metadata cardinality
panels.description: Distinct metadata combinations the batch processor keeps separate batches for (`otelcol_processor_batch_metadata_cardinality`). Grows only with metadata_keys; should stay small (1-2).

panels.title: Exporter queue usage
panels.description: Sending queue fill ratio per exporter (grafana.com 15983 'Exporter Queue Usage': `max(otelcol_exporter_queue_size) / min(otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity)`). Rising usage = the backend (Tempo / Prometheus / Loki / gateway) is slow or down; at 100% data is dropped.

targets.expr: max by (job, exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"}) / min by (job, exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity{namespace="opentelemetry", job=~"$job"})

panels.title: Exporter queue size / capacity
panels.description: Batches waiting in each exporter's sending queue (`otelcol_exporter_queue_size`) against the configured capacity (`otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity`: 2000 on the agent, 5000 on gateway/logs).

panels.title: Exporter in-flight requests
panels.description: Requests currently being sent by each exporter (`otelcol_exporter_in_flight_requests`). Stuck high = the backend hangs.

panels.title: file_log: files tracked
panels.description: Files the otel-logs file_log receiver keeps open and is actively reading (`otelcol_fileconsumer_open_files`, `otelcol_fileconsumer_reading_files`). Open files ~ number of containers on the node; reading > 0 for long = it is behind.

panels.title: k8s_attributes: pod association
panels.description: Result of matching telemetry to a pod by the k8s_attributes processor (`otelcol.k8s.pod.association`, status success/error). Errors = records without Kubernetes metadata (short-lived pods already gone, host-network sources).

panels.title: k8s_attributes: pod cache
panels.description: Pods held in the k8s_attributes informer cache (`otelcol.k8s.watcher.pod_cache.size`) and watch events per minute (added/updated/deleted). The cache should track the pods of the node.

panels.title: CPU (cores) per collector
panels.description: CPU used by each collector process (grafana.com 15983 'CPU Usage': `rate(otelcol_process_cpu_seconds)`).

panels.title: Memory: RSS vs container limit
panels.description: Process RSS (`otelcol_process_memory_rss`, 15983 'Total RSS Memory') and the container memory limit (kube-state-metrics). memory_limiter starts refusing at 80% of the limit; the kernel OOM-kills at 100%.

panels.title: Go heap / allocation rate
panels.description: Live heap (`otelcol_process_runtime_heap_alloc_bytes`) and allocation rate (`otelcol_process_runtime_total_alloc_bytes`), 15983 'Total Runtime Heap Memory'. High allocation with low throughput = expensive processors (OTTL transforms, regex).
